name: cssints
description: CSS in TypeScript: typed css.* calls compiled to atomic CSS at build time (a Vite plugin)

scripts.test: cd test && node run.mjs fixtures/risk*.ts fixtures/typed*.ts fixtures/tokens-typed.ts fixtures/tokens-named.ts fixtures/tokens-use.ts fixtures/tokens-style.ts fixtures/helper-use.ts fixtures/cv.ts fixtures/scv.ts fixtures/order.ts fixtures/conditions.ts fixtures/cond-use.ts fixtures/cn-runtime.ts fixtures/cn-static.ts fixtures/chain.ts fixtures/math.ts fixtures/pending.ts fixtures/unreached.ts fixtures/cv-top.ts fixtures/type-import.ts fixtures/shorthand.ts fixtures/runtime-globals-ok.ts && node run.mjs fixtures/unreached.ts | grep -q 'off = false && "_' && node run.mjs fixtures/unreached.ts | grep -q 'gap > 9 ? "_' && node run.mjs fixtures/runtime-arg.ts | grep -q 'must be known at build time: .n. is not defined' && node run.mjs fixtures/runtime-global.ts | grep -q 'must be known at build time: .open. is not defined' && node run.mjs fixtures/runtime-global-block.ts | grep -q 'must be known at build time: .name. is not defined' && node run.mjs fixtures/runtime-shadow.ts | grep -q 'must be known at build time: .n. is not defined' && ! node run.mjs fixtures/invalid.ts > /dev/null && node run.mjs fixtures/no-attribute.ts | grep -q "without the attribute" && node run.mjs fixtures/chain-error.ts | grep -q "has no .padding()" && node run.mjs fixtures/shorthand-bad.ts | grep -q "flex: unexpected .sideways." && node run.mjs fixtures/shorthand-chain.ts | grep -q "plain styles do not chain" && node run.mjs fixtures/line-clamp.ts 2>&1 | grep -q "{-webkit-line-clamp:3}" && node run.mjs fixtures/line-clamp.ts 2>&1 | grep -q "{-webkit-box-orient:vertical}" && node run.mjs fixtures/line-clamp.ts 2>&1 | grep -q "{display:-webkit-box}" && !
